implementation: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 Kernel Cryptographic API (CTS_CPACF_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: CBC-CS generic C non-optimized block mode using CPACF AES implementation.
